boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented JCU study settings, from quiet library rooms and collaborative work areas to residence-hall lounges with clear access limitations.

cards.entity_name: Grasselli Library Third-Floor Quiet Study Room
cards.title: Settle Into the Third-Floor Quiet Room
cards.subtitle: An enclosed quiet-study space inside Grasselli Library
cards.notes: Bring independent work and use headphones elsewhere; this enclosed third-floor room was created specifically for quiet study.
cards.short_summary: A library room purpose-built for students who need a quieter setting and access to nearby collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The documented Grasselli Library renovation added an enclosed quiet-study room on the third floor in response to requests for more quiet space and electrical outlets.
cards.source_title: Grasselli Library enters phase one of renovation
cards.access_notes: Located inside Grasselli Library; use is subject to current library building access and operating hours.

cards.title: Bring the Project Team to a Meeting Room
cards.subtitle: Enclosed collaborative rooms in Grasselli Library
cards.notes: Use this setting for discussion-heavy assignments, and confirm any room-use or reservation rules with library staff before meeting.
cards.short_summary: A defined library option for group work that keeps active conversation separate from quieter study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll University's library page states that Grasselli Library contains group meeting rooms among its study facilities.
cards.access_notes: Inside Grasselli Library; the public page confirms the rooms but does not publish current reservation rules, so check with library staff.

cards.title: Switch to a Library Workstation
cards.subtitle: A technology-equipped area on Grasselli Library's renovated ground floor
cards.notes: Choose this area when an assignment needs campus computing; verify workstation availability and login requirements when you arrive.
cards.short_summary: A distinct ground-floor library destination suited to coursework that depends on computer access.
cards.evidence_claim: The renovated Grasselli Library ground floor opened for spring 2025 and includes the Computer Commons.
cards.source_title: Grasselli Library completes ground floor renovations with more construction underway
cards.access_notes: On Grasselli Library's ground floor; workstation eligibility and building access may depend on current JCU policies.

cards.title: Sketch Out an Idea in the Curiosity Lounge
cards.subtitle: A named lounge on Grasselli Library's renovated ground floor
cards.notes: Bring early-stage research or planning work here, then move to a quiet room if your task requires silence or extended concentration.
cards.short_summary: A named library lounge that offers an alternative to conventional desks and enclosed meeting rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The renovated Grasselli Library ground floor includes a named Curiosity Lounge alongside student services and study-oriented facilities.
cards.source_title: Grasselli Library completes ground floor renovations with more construction underway
cards.access_notes: Located on Grasselli Library's ground floor and available only when the building and applicable area are open.

cards.title: Take a Reading Break in The Den
cards.subtitle: A named space within the renovated Grasselli Library ground floor
cards.notes: Use the Den for reading or lighter coursework, and keep a backup library zone in mind if scheduled activity occupies the space.
cards.short_summary: A newly documented ground-floor library setting for changing pace without leaving the academic hub.
cards.evidence_claim: The Den is one of the named spaces included on Grasselli Library's renovated ground floor, which opened to the JCU community in spring 2025.
cards.source_title: Grasselli Library completes ground floor renovations with more construction underway
cards.access_notes: Located inside Grasselli Library; confirm current availability after entering because the source does not specify booking rules.

cards.title: Pair Study Time With Academic Support
cards.subtitle: A library-based commons for academic and career guidance
cards.notes: Work nearby before an advising visit, and consult the relevant service directly when you need an appointment or specialized assistance.
cards.short_summary: A central Grasselli Library destination that combines student-support offices with a commons environment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mastrantoni Family Student Success Commons is located in Grasselli Library and centralizes academic advising and career services.
cards.source_title: John Carroll University Alumni Magazine, Spring 2022
cards.access_notes: The commons is in Grasselli Library; individual support services may require appointments and maintain separate schedules.

cards.title: Keep It Quiet Upstairs in Dolan
cards.subtitle: A small second-floor lounge for Dolan Hall residents
cards.notes: Bring focused individual work and respect the lounge's quiet purpose; use requires residence-hall access rather than general campus entry.
cards.short_summary: A compact residential study option documented as Dolan Hall's quiet upstairs lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: JCU describes Dolan Hall as having a small second-floor quiet lounge and identifies it as first-year housing for 2026–27.
cards.access_notes: Residence-hall space for authorized Dolan Hall residents and permitted guests; Dolan is designated first-year housing.

cards.title: Use Hamlin's Dedicated Study Lounges
cards.subtitle: Resident study lounges provided on every floor of Hamlin Hall
cards.notes: Pick the lounge nearest your room for routine coursework, and follow residence-life guest and quiet-hour policies while using it.
cards.short_summary: Distributed residential study areas that let Hamlin residents work without leaving their building.
cards.evidence_claim: John Carroll University's Hamlin Hall page states that the building has study lounges on every floor in addition to a separate TV lounge.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to authorized Hamlin Hall residents and permitted guests; residence halls close briefly during winter break.

cards.title: Spread Out in Hamlin's Third-Floor Lobby
cards.subtitle: A larger resident commons designed for studying and meetings
cards.notes: Use the larger footprint for collaborative work or meetings, while yielding to scheduled community activities and residence policies.
cards.short_summary: A more spacious Hamlin alternative when a floor study lounge does not fit the group's task.
cards.evidence_claim: JCU identifies Hamlin Hall's large third-floor common lobby as a central space for studying, meetings, group activities, and social connection.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to authorized Hamlin Hall residents and permitted guests; shared programming may affect availability.

cards.entity_name: Campion Hall STEM LLC Study Spaces
cards.title: Meet With the STEM LLC in Campion
cards.subtitle: Dedicated residential study spaces for the STEM Living Learning Community
cards.notes: Use these spaces for STEM coursework and faculty-mentored collaboration only when your housing or LLC access authorizes entry.
cards.short_summary: A residence-based academic setting tied specifically to Campion Hall's STEM Living Learning Community.
cards.evidence_claim: JCU states that first-year STEM LLC members live together on designated Campion Hall floors with dedicated study spaces and faculty mentorship.
cards.access_notes: For authorized Campion Hall residents and STEM LLC participants as applicable; the LLC requires selection through the housing process.
